title: Highlights from the 4th Credit Suisse Private Innovation Circle
description: Credit Suisse explores where new growth starts: 9 game-changing ventures, 120 global investors, eminent experts and speakers met in Zurich at the 4th Private Innovation Circle. Watch the video to see the highlights and find out more about the ventures.   Find out more: https://www.credit-suisse.com/pic  The entrepreneurial mindset is deeply rooted in Credit Suisse's culture. The bank's annual Private Innovation Circle aims to bring entrepreneurs to investors and investors to entrepreneurs. #CSPIC  Connect with us on: LinkedIn: http://Linkedin.com/company/credit-suisse Twitter: http://Twitter.com/creditsuisse Facebook: http://Facebook.com/creditsuisse

asr.full_text: The objectives of the Private Innovation Circle are to showcase excellence in innovation, facilitate the exchange of ideas, and foster a collaboration between entrepreneurs and investors. The object of the innovation circle is to enable these companies to move to the next stage in terms of funding growing their customer base and beginning to flourish. Credit Suisse has been really crucial to meet new people within new ecosystems and new markets. I think this is something that will really benefit us over the next few years. Number one, obviously the ability to fundraise, and number two the access to networking relationships that could support us, our business. We definitely want to work with strategic investors that would help us open the market, as well as bring us strategic partnerships as well as strategic customers We see a lot of benefit in participating with a very strong brand like Credit Suisse that has global reach. We're also meeting Credit Suisse, we're learning as a company what they can do for us and there's a couple of very interesting opportunities. And also individually for us it's interesting because we're business angels and we've just met another eight very very interesting companies that we could definitely think about investing into and the way that they were curated and what they are offering is very interesting to us. It is a believing sport so to say and not an intellectual one. Only thing you can try to systemize is historical things that worked and that didn't work and the common one denominator is that if you have a strong founder who is driven by passion and not by money, that is the thing that normally changes the entire equation. Entrepreneurial drive is a mindset that Credit Suisse shares with its clients addressing the challenges of today and seeking the opportunity of tomorrow are at the foundation of our common drive to foster economic growth social progress and sustainability. We are aiming to use this as a platform to build a thriving community of accomplished innovators and entrepreneurs who engage with the benefit from each other on a regular basis.
